recap.text: Silfa, a plump Wisteria Fairy and Holistic Healer, rides in the Vermillion engine cab. She refuses to heal Crawler Katia until her health hits 25 percent and runs into the engineer's apartment during a horde. After healing Hekla, Silfa reveals Eva told her to stop healing and that the mages were told to kill Crawler Carl. Silfa owns a bakery and slips out the door as Brynhild's Daughters dissolves.

Crawler Silfa and her two daughters are dead. Crawler Katia reports that the three formed a party with Eva, and Eva got them killed. Carl remembers Silfa as an older woman who turned herself into a healer and served as bait. Eva has increased her player killer marks.

beats.headline: The healer rides up front
beats.text: For the record: on the Vermillion engine's run to station 101, one more daughter rides in the cab. Silfa, Wisteria Fairy, level twenty-five, Holistic Healer. Plump, about fifty in appearance, half the size of Crawler Donut. She hangs back quietly. Crawler Carl hopes her healing works better in here than holistic snake oil did at home, eyes her nervously because he has never fought beside her, and keeps eight scrolls of healing ready anyway. Crawler Donut has six more.
beats.gist: Silfa, a plump Wisteria Fairy and level twenty-five Holistic Healer, rides in the Vermillion engine's cab.

beats.headline: Supposed to wait for 25
beats.text: Crawler Katia is the train's scoop and her health keeps falling, and subject has not healed her once. When a blister ghoul torso reaches for her, subject buzzes to the ceiling screaming for Hekla. Pressed, she says she is supposed to wait until Katia is at 25 percent. She looks at Hekla. Hekla nods. Then she heals. Before the next horde Crawler Carl gives her exact orders, and again she looks to Hekla first. When the horde hits, subject runs into the engineer's apartment.
beats.gist: Silfa refuses to heal Katia until she reaches 25 percent health and runs into the engineer's apartment.

beats.headline: She heals Hekla
beats.text: Crawler Donut puts a full-strength Magic Missile into Hekla's face for the invisible bolts, and the cab fills with the Daughters: Eva with her swords, two mages with glowing hands, and subject out of the apartment with her eyes wide. Hekla is back on her feet shouting hold, fully healed by subject. Then Hekla sends the mages out, and subject with them. They wait right outside the door.
beats.gist: Donut hits Hekla in the face with a Magic Missile, and Silfa heals Hekla.

beats.headline: Bait, and a bakery
beats.text: After Hekla's death Donut spots a blue dot hiding in the apartment. Subject bolts for the exit and is pinned under the gore; one weak ice spell at Crawler Carl. Traitor, she tells Katia. Carl explains she was bait. She insists Hekla would never. Then: Eva told her to stop healing, not Hekla. The two mages outside are her real daughters, told to kill Carl first if anything went wrong. I own a bakery, subject says. I just want my girls to be safe.
beats.gist: Donut spots a blue dot in the apartment; the subject bolts and is pinned under gore.

beats.headline: The Daughters are no more
beats.text: Subject's account of what is left. With Hekla dead, Eva is automatically party leader, and nobody likes her; they are leaving. Brynhild's Daughters is no more. Hardly any equipment, no personal space. Most share Hekla's sponsor, the crab ranch, which has never sent them anything. What are we going to do? Crawler Carl does not know, only that it cannot be with them. He opens the door enough for her to slip out, and on the other side three women start to sob.
beats.gist: Silfa says Brynhild's Daughters is no more and the group is leaving because nobody likes Eva.

beats.headline: Back with Eva
beats.text: Crawler Silfa is dead. So are her two daughters. The report is Crawler Katia's, given on the fifth floor: despite everything, the three formed a new party with Eva, Katia tried to talk them out of it, and in Katia's words Eva got them killed. Crawler Carl remembers subject as the older woman who turned herself into a healer, and who was used as bait. It seems so long ago. Eva has increased her player killer marks.
beats.gist: Silfa and her two daughters are dead after Eva got them killed.
